content.text: Register doesn't pass provider, so the default applies.

candidates.explanation: When createUserDto.provider is undefined, provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google. AuthService.register calls usersService.create with no provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. Login then fails the check `user.provider !== AuthProvidersEnum.email` in AuthService.validateLogin and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.
Register doesn't explicitly set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email, so it relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Default to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google at line 126. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
